product_metadata.title: mDesign Steel Over Door Hanging Shower Caddy Storage Organizer with 2 Baskets, 6 Hooks - Shelf Rack for Bathroom - Holds Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap, Towel, Sponge - Draper Collection - Chrome/White
features: STORAGE MADE SIMPLE: Keep bathing essentials close at hand with this convenient shower door caddy; It features 2 shelf baskets, 2 large hooks, and 4 small hooks to hold face towels, loofahs or razors; Two strong suction cups keep caddy firmly in place in wet or dry bathroom environments; The open grid design allows for maximum water drainage and air circulation so that items dry quickly

EASY INSTALLATION: Hang this convenient organizer over shower doors for instant storage; The suction cups keep the caddy secure and in place - clean and dry the surface area before pressing the suction cups firmly to the surface; Suction cups work on smooth nonporous surfaces such as glass, tile, mirrors and fiberglass; Perfect for home, apartments, condos, dorms, RVs and campers; Arms extend and rotate to perfectly fit your space - Easy-to-follow instructions are included

FUNCTIONAL & VERSATILE: This 2 tier caddy organizer has space to store a wide variety of products in multiple shapes and sizes; Built-in hooks for washcloths, back brushes, loofahs, poufs, pumice stones, razors and more; The large baskets are great for storing shampoo, conditioner, body wash, hand soap, razors, shaving cream, oils, facial cleansers, leave-in conditioners and salt scrubs; Two strong suction cups keep this organizer caddy in place and secure
QUALITY CONSTRUCTION: Made from sturdy steel wire with a durable finish; Plastic suction cups; Suction cups adhere best to clean smooth, non-porous surfaces; Easy Care - Clean with damp cloth
THOUGHTFULLY SIZED: Measures 6" x 9.3" x 12" high; Arms extend from 11.1" to 16.6" high; Fits over shower and interior doors up to 1.4" / 3.6cm thick
